answer: Sybils must replicate that costly work per fake identity, and the stake sits on a shared mesa of escrowed value: any duplicate-identity challenge burns it. Each agent must forge a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then stake tokens locked until a fixed horizon. Attackers therefore pay escalating compute plus locked capital for every clone, making mass identity farming economically irrational. From sa0019's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
